title: RecordedPreview
responsibility: Shows the pinned runtime screenshot of an implemented visual unit.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: The selected project and commit, and its evidence connection.

inputs.name: entityId
inputs.description: The page or component to preview.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: The readable name used for the screenshot description.

inputs.name: thumbnail
inputs.description: The recorded scenario, state and viewport; older pages may name their state in the recorded contract.

inputs.name: RecordedPreview.compact
inputs.description: Defaults to false. Hide the caption for minimal page cards; keep capture origin and missing-image details available on hover.

outputs.name: preview
outputs.description: A checked screenshot with its state and tested commit, or an explicit loading or unavailable state.
